About Me

Code is craft.
I take it seriously.

I'm a Computer Science bachelor's student with a deep interest in full-stack systems, algorithm design, and the intersection of software with real-world problems.

My work spans citizen-facing government platforms, academic research, and published authorship — I believe great software starts with clarity of purpose and ends with clean, maintainable code.

When I'm not coding, I'm writing — either technical books or exploring computer science concepts that challenge conventional thinking.

Full-Stack · Civic Tech

NADRA Citizen Management System

A full-stack web application simulating Pakistan's national citizen identity system. Supports citizen registration, CNIC issuance workflows, record search, and administrative dashboards. Built with a structured relational database and a clean interface for both citizens and staff operators.

PythonMySQLHTML/CSSFull-Stack

Java · OOP System

Library Management System

A console-based and GUI-extended library system built in Java. Manages book catalogues, member registrations, borrow/return cycles, and overdue tracking. Applies core OOP principles including inheritance, encapsulation, and polymorphism in a real-world context.

C++ · Algorithms

DSA Algorithm Visualizer

An interactive program demonstrating classic data structures and sorting algorithms — including binary trees, heaps, linked lists, bubble sort, quick sort, and merge sort — with step-by-step console output. Built in C++ for deep understanding of low-level operations.

Student GPA & Grade Tracker

A Python application for managing student academic records — tracking course grades, calculating semester and cumulative GPA, and generating simple reports. Designed with usability in mind for students and advisors alike, with data persistence via file storage.

Peer-to-Peer Chat Application

A socket-based chat application in Java enabling real-time communication between clients. Implements multithreaded server handling, message broadcasting, and basic user session management. A practical introduction to network programming and concurrent systems.

Writing is thinking made visible. These books reflect my commitment to making computer science accessible and rigorous.

🧠
Computer Science · Education

Algorithms Demystified

A beginner-to-intermediate guide breaking down algorithmic thinking through real-world examples, pseudocode, and illustrated walkthroughs. Written to bridge the gap between theory and implementation for CS students.

Python · Programming Guide

Python from Zero to Project

A practical programming book designed for absolute beginners. Covers Python fundamentals, object-oriented programming, file handling, and culminates in building three complete real-world projects — no prior experience required.

🗄️
Database Design · Reference

Database Design for Developers

A concise, developer-focused guide to relational database design. Covers normalisation, schema planning, SQL query optimisation, and real schema case studies — including civic and academic database examples drawn from personal project experience.
